title: NEAT, DQN stop training: the tournament becomes a duel
text: Thursday 21:50, at your request: from now on the tournament is a duel between PPO and Mini-AlphaZero, the two that learned to win the fight for space. NEAT and DQN stop training; their last checkpoints stay as fixed opponents on the Play page. Knockout 2 (Fri 06:00) is cancelled; the final on Friday 16:00 is PPO against Mini-AlphaZero. Each of the two now trains on 4 cores. At the same time: Mini-AlphaZero searches deeper (128 simulations per move instead of 48 in training and 32 in matches) and plays 30% of its practice games against PPO's newest network; PPO gets a territory bonus (it's paid for gaining space on the opponent) and plays 15% of its practice games against Mini-AlphaZero's network.
